emptyMessage.description: Rendered in place of the chart when `data` holds no usable matrix.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the chart. Falls back to a generated summary.

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of an element elsewhere on the page that describes the chart.

title.description: Human title rendered into the SVG's `<title>`.

description.description: Long description rendered into the SVG's `<desc>`. Falls back to a generated one.

keyboardNavigable.description: Set false to make the chart inert to Tab and the arrow keys. Defaults to true.
